scope: Atomic internal-vibration operation for freshly placed stair concrete; concrete supply, placement, formwork, reinforcement, finishing and curing remain with their owning operations.

sources.exactLocator: Public preview pp. 1-2: consolidation removes entrapped air; contents identify vibration, internal vibrators, procedure and quality control. The public preview does not provide universal productivity.
IRFU45/230/5 technical-data row: 0.88 kW, 45 mm head, 5 m hose, 15 m cable, 12,000 1/min, IP67, 220-240 V.
All productivity, labor, rental, cleaning, quality-control and logistics values are visible inputs and must be replaced by the approved method statement, equipment schedule and supplier quote.

selectedPreliminaryProfile.assumptionPolicy: ACI 309 is used only for method applicability. Machine productivity, labor productivity and support quantities are editable first-estimate assumptions, never universal ACI or manufacturer norms; equipment suitability must be confirmed against the stair geometry, reinforcement spacing and approved method statement. Machine-hours describe use, rental shifts are the payable equipment owner, and the informational machine-use row must not be priced again. Cleaning labor and water are calculated per used vibrator, not copied from operating machine-hours.

engineeringLimitations: Manufacturer power and head data do not prove the visible 3 m3/machine-hour or 0.8 m3/man-hour planning assumptions; those values require replacement by the approved method or norm.
Machine use is informational and rental shifts own equipment cost. Cleaning has its own labor quantity and does not reuse operating machine-hours, preventing double payment.
The profile does not calculate or procure concrete; concrete belongs to the placement operation.
The 45 mm head is a preliminary equipment selection and requires confirmation against member dimensions, reinforcement spacing and mixture workability.
Automatic hours are first-estimate planning quantities derived from visible editable productivities, not quoted ACI productivities.
Unknown prices remain null until a supplier or project price source is selected.
Waste-water handling is a visible planning scope and must be reconciled with the approved environmental method.
